title: Set Up: The Mystery Feely Bag

scenes.tts: You need a pillowcase and eight to ten objects with different textures. Keep a metal spoon, a wooden spoon, and a spoon from the fridge aside for later.
scenes.narration: You need a pillowcase and eight to ten objects with different textures. Keep a metal spoon, a wooden spoon, and a spoon from the fridge aside for later.

scenes.tts: Pack the bag yourself. Your child feels one object without looking and gives three describing words, then guesses. Later, add the metal and wooden spoons.
scenes.narration: Pack the bag yourself. Your child feels one object without looking and gives three describing words, then guesses. Later, add the metal and wooden spoons.

scenes.tts: Most children find the metal spoon feels colder, though both are at room temperature. The fridge spoon usually stays dry.
scenes.narration: Most children find the metal spoon feels colder, though both are at room temperature. The fridge spoon usually stays dry.

scenes.tts: Stay with your child and check every object. Use objects too big to fit inside a toilet paper tube. Nothing sharp, hot, frozen, breakable, or alive goes in the bag.

items.text: Nothing small, sharp, hot, or frozen
